question: Should OpenClaw accept a native compaction result produced immediately after safety-timeout cancellation while the safety wrapper still owns and accepts that exact timeout reason?
rationale: The implementation can mechanically bound the acceptance window, but choosing whether aborted timeout work may commit session state is a product/runtime policy decision that source inspection alone cannot authorize.

options.title: Accept bounded timeout commits
options.body: Keep the exact-reason WeakSet acceptance window and land after rebasing and refreshing exact-head checks.

options.title: Keep native timeout fail-closed
options.body: Retain inner chunk partial summaries and timeout guidance but remove the AgentSession exception so every timeout-aborted native result is discarded.

options.title: Require live gateway proof
options.body: Pause landing until a realistic slow-provider or full gateway run demonstrates recovery without a late or duplicated session mutation.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded timeout commits
recommendation.body: Keep the exact-reason WeakSet acceptance window and land after rebasing and refreshing exact-head checks.

likelyOwner.reason: The assigned reviewer has the strongest recent history in the affected compaction timeout surface and is the clearest owner for this runtime policy choice.
